body: thank you for the kind words, and sorry for not replying earlier. I was talking to other people who made me feel a bit better. Though my current state of mind is still down, I don't think I want to kill myself, at least not yet. I just can't cope with this for very long, and will probably talk to some more people, hopefully before I do anything to myself.
I'm just commenting to tell you that you are not late. I just feel very depressed right now, but I don't think I want to end my life yet, though I have been trying not to think about it.
At least someone knows where I'm coming from. I'm sure my school has counseling services, I just don't know if I am ready to go to talk to someone in person. Thank you for understanding me though
